description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing in Apache Spark, including methods for creating JAR files, checking for job spills, handling HTTP connections, and managing Spark listeners.

classes.name: SpillListener
classes.description: A SparkListener that detects whether spills have occurred in Spark jobs by monitoring task metrics and stage completion events.

methods.name: createJarWithClasses
methods.description: Creates a JAR file containing classes with specified names, optionally with base classes and classpath URLs.

methods.name: createJarWithFiles
methods.description: Creates a JAR file containing specified files with given contents.

methods.name: createJar
methods.description: Creates a JAR file from a sequence of files, with optional directory prefix and main class.

methods.name: assertSpilled
methods.description: Runs code and asserts that Spark jobs involving the code spill to disk.

methods.name: assertNotSpilled
methods.description: Runs code and asserts that Spark jobs involving the code do not spill.

methods.name: assertExceptionMsg
methods.description: Checks that an exception or its causes contain a specific message and optionally matches a specific exception type.

methods.name: testCommandAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a command-line command is available on the system.

methods.name: isPythonVersionAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the installed Python version meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: getAbsolutePathFromExecutable
methods.description: Finds the absolute path of an executable in the system PATH.

methods.name: httpResponseCode
methods.description: Gets the HTTP response code from a URL.

methods.name: redirectUrl
methods.description: Gets the redirect URL from an HTTP response.

methods.name: httpResponseMessage
methods.description: Gets the response message body from an HTTP URL.

methods.name: withHttpConnection
methods.description: Executes a function with an HTTP connection, handling SSL trust for HTTPS.

methods.name: withListener
methods.description: Runs code with a SparkListener installed, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: withHttpServer
methods.description: Starts a temporary HTTP server for testing purposes.

methods.name: waitUntilExecutorsUp
methods.description: Waits until a specified number of Spark executors are active or times out.

methods.name: configTestLog4j2
methods.description: Configures log4j2 logging for tests.

methods.name: recursiveList
methods.description: Recursively lists all files in a directory.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Lists files in a directory recursively, skipping hidden or system files.

methods.name: createTempJsonFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary JSON file with specified JSON content.

methods.name: createTempScriptWithExpectedOutput
methods.description: Creates a temporary bash script that outputs specified text.
